milestone: Model-owned preparation of all native DeepSeek core FP16 projections
status: Qualified storage/preparation and selected consumer composition; whole inference/vLLM goal remains active

implementation.anatomy: Architecture planning emits every logical core projection with explicit layer/weight role/scale role/tensor IDs/geometry/order. Backend code consumes this metadata without family names.
implementation.preflight: Registry-driven validation of every pair, unique bindings, coverage of every native FP8 layer role, complete source extents, checked aggregate resident/device-tile peak/host staging bounds. Budget rejection occurs before any weight creation.
implementation.ownership: One backend-owned container retains all330 decoded core weights. Staged backend resource transfer publishes only after every constructor succeeds. Failures free staged weights and preserve existing destination resources; model publication leaves no backend state on failure. Constant-time layer/role lookup returns immutable borrowed weights.
implementation.scope: Only330 block-scaled core projections. BF16/F32 parameters, embedding/head, Engram tables, experts, requests and library/context overhead are separate resources. Backend stores no index pointer; the model expert catalog still borrows the index for model lifetime.
implementation.budgets: Requested final GPU payload plus exactly one constructor tile; maximum explicit FP8/scale/F16 host tile staging. Metadata, test arrays, page cache, CUDA internal staging, allocator/context/library/driver memory excluded.

validation.reference: Unchanged upstream dequant_e8m0_blocks_ AST with original native checkpoint FP8/UE8M0 bytes, then bit-preserving transpose. All330 references captured and frozen before production owner implementation.
validation.consumer: Two request streams share model-owned layer0 Q_A: M1/M64, F16/F32 outputs, three repeats,499200 exact outputwords per native/ASAN/memcheck run against previously frozen paired-library source references.
validation.synthetic: Independent aggregate byte arithmetic, complete pair coverage, duplicate/wrong-shape/format/role rejection before GPU creation, budgets one byte below bounds, failed constructors1/100/330, retry, foreign destination owner preservation, exact map/zero-weight contents and automatic model teardown.

memory_profile.scope: All330 native core F16 weights retained in model-owned backend; preparation/readback/teardown only, no request allocations in this capture.
memory_profile.limitations: Native requested payload plus one GPU tile, not total VRAM: context/static/library/driver overhead separate. Host bound covers explicit FP8/scale/F16 tiles, not metadata, CUDA internal staging, page cache or test readback/reference buffers. No cold/steady inference throughput or vLLM parity claim.

limitations: No full native transformer forward/generation admission or vLLM parity claim.
Other native parameters and bounded expert residency/async routing still require integration. HC4, compressed/indexed shared KV, Engram and complete sessions remain unfinished.
Packed-weight equality is whole-set; numerical projection-consumer validation here is layer0 Q_A only. Broader dense primitive qualification remains in the prior stage.
No total VRAM/RSS, cold-start, steady inference throughput, NEON/Metal/WASM qualification claim.
